From the root of the project, PowerShell:

Executable code/The commands are omitted in the documentary copy.

Integrity check first. Ready stages, including timeouts, re-run They don't do it, they don't JOURNAL.jsonl It's written down. Repeat enlarged The budget must receive a new folder or a new attempt; the old outcome It's not changed.

  • inputs/: 12 fresh entrances; seed and order in experiment.py.
  • shift_solver.py: a new basis, a structural choice of direction and LLL.
  • results/Five separate entry stages, including limits and omissions.
  • constructions/, progress/: the design is maintained until LLL.
  • lattices/Accurate reduced bases and certified polynomials.
  • algebra/, algebra_checkpoints/: solutions and available transformations.
  • ARITHMETIC.json: six small checks of divisibility and equality of lattice.
  • audit.py, AUDIT.json, audit_packets/independent disclosures, HNF, Certificates of reduction and algebra, complete control of chains and masks.
  • CONTROLS.json, MEASUREMENTS.json, COMPARISON.json, AXIS_SELECTIONS.jsonResults, times and choice of variables.
  • RETRY_INDEX.json: index of records timeout/total_budget/ preparation_unavailable folder results preserved SEQ-series; baseline, SHA256 It's not a substitute for journals.
  • REAL.jsonStructural calculation; no real search.
  • PROVENANCE.json, PRIOR_SNAPSHOT.json, ENVIRONMENT.json: origin of the code, SHA256/mtime previous files, existing libraries.
  • RESUME_CHECK.json, ACCEPTANCE.json, COMPLETE.json, ARTIFACTS.json: Continuation without counting, acceptance and integrity.

Saved inputs allow for a repeat of the limited launch state LLL or Gröbner is not usually retained; guarantees There is no continuation with the interrupted machine instruction.

One computational CPU-process. Python 3.11.9, python-flint 0.9.0, SymPy 1.14.0. Without installations and GPU. Do 90 (c) to prepare each grid, 30 (c) for each decision, 45 on primal; general budget 1200 s. Audit separately: up to 180 The end of the process can be a little bit scale up wall time relative to a given limit.
